meta.title: 8-Day Marrakech Adventure & Sahara Desert Tour | Shared Morocco Adventures
meta.description: An 8-day shared Marrakech tour combining Ourika Valley, Agafay Desert and Ouzoud Waterfalls excursions with a 3-day Sahara desert loop. From €359pp.
meta.ogDescription: Marrakech excursions (Ourika, Agafay, Ouzoud) plus a 3-day Sahara desert loop via Dades Gorges and Merzouga. From €359pp.

hero.lead: Ourika → Agafay → Ouzoud → Dades Gorges → Merzouga Desert Camp → Marrakech

overview.h2: Marrakech's excursions, plus a night in the dunes
paras: This is our 5-Day Shared Marrakech Adventure Tour extended with a full 3-day Sahara desert loop — the Ourika Valley, the Agafay Desert (camel ride and ATV), and the Ouzoud Waterfalls as round-trip day excursions from Marrakech, followed by a classic Sahara run via the Dades Gorges to a camel trek and desert camp night at Merzouga, then back to Marrakech.
Transport runs in a shared minivan throughout, and accommodation is shared — the same combination that keeps our other tours well below private-tour pricing for the same ground covered.

days.label: Arrive
days.title: Arrival in Marrakech
paras: Pick-up from Marrakech Menara Airport (RAK) and private transfer to your hostel in the medina. The rest of the day is free to explore Jemaa el-Fnaa square and the surrounding souks.

days.label: Ourika
days.title: Ourika Valley Excursion
days.lead: ≈84 km round trip · about 2 hrs total driving
paras: Round-trip drive into the Atlas Mountains foothills — Berber villages, terraced fields, an argan oil cooperative, and an optional short hike toward the Setti Fatma waterfalls. Return to Marrakech by early evening.

days.label: Agafay
days.title: Agafay Desert: Camel Ride & ATV/Quad Biking
days.lead: ≈70 km round trip · about 1–1.5 hrs total driving
paras: Short drive to the rocky Agafay Desert for a camel ride and an ATV/quad biking session, with views back toward the Atlas Mountains. Return to Marrakech.

days.label: Ouzoud
days.title: Ouzoud Waterfalls Excursion
days.lead: ≈300–310 km round trip · about 5–6 hrs total driving
paras: Full-day round trip to Ouzoud, North Africa's tallest waterfall (~110m) — viewpoints, a walk to the base, Barbary macaques, and an optional boat ride. Return to Marrakech in the evening.

days.label: Depart
days.title: Marrakech to Dades Gorges
paras: Leave Marrakech and cross the High Atlas via the Tizi n'Tichka pass, stopping at the UNESCO-listed Ait Benhaddou kasbah, before continuing to an overnight stay in the Dades Valley. Pack a small overnight bag for this leg — your main luggage stays safely stored at the Marrakech hostel.

days.label: Desert
days.title: Dades to Merzouga via Todra Gorge
paras: Morning walk through the Dades Gorge, then on to the towering Todra Gorge (≈55 km/1 hr) for a short hike, continuing to Merzouga (≈180 km/3.5 hrs). Camel trek into the Erg Chebbi dunes for a night at a shared desert camp — dinner around the fire, live music, and a night under the stars.

days.label: Return
days.title: Merzouga back to Marrakech
days.lead: ≈560 km total · about 8.5 hrs driving with stops
paras: Optional sunrise over the dunes before camels carry the group back to Merzouga. Scenic drive back across the Atlas (≈350 km/5.5 hrs), with a stop in Ouarzazate, then a final ≈210 km/3.5 hrs to Marrakech by evening — back to the same hostel for your last night.

days.label: Depart
days.title: Departure
paras: Free morning depending on flight time, then private transfer from your hostel to Marrakech Menara Airport (RAK) for departure. Trip ends.

intro: Seven nights, shared throughout. Marrakech nights use the same hostel from the 5-Day Marrakech Adventure Tour.

cards.title: Nights 1–4 & 7 · Marrakech
html: Riad Dia, immediately next to Jemaa el-Fnaa — 9.3/10 on Hostelworld, rooftop pool, free breakfast and WiFi. Backup: Hostel Riad Marrakech Rouge, 2 minutes from the square.

cards.title: Night 5 · Dades Gorges
html: Luxury Dades Riad or Auberge Tissadrin, half board (HB) — a kasbah-style riad with mudbrick rooms and terrace gorge views, dinner included.

cards.title: Night 6 · Merzouga desert camp
html: Ideal Desert Camp, half board (HB) — a Berber-style camp at the edge of the Erg Chebbi dunes with dinner and breakfast included, campfire music, and a night under the stars.

notes: Confirm current nightly rates and availability directly before booking — hostel pricing shifts seasonally.

includes: Shared minivan transport for all excursions and the desert loop
Camel ride and ATV/quad rental (Agafay, Day 3)
Camel trek and 1 night at the Sahara desert camp
excludes: Private rooms (available on request, extra cost)

good.h2: Two trips in one, at a bundled price
paras: This route combines our 5-Day Shared Marrakech Adventure Tour with our 4-Day Sahara Desert Group Tour into one continuous booking, priced below what the two would cost separately.
Prefer just the Marrakech excursions without the desert? See the 5-Day Shared Marrakech Adventure Tour. Want the Sahara loop on its own? See the 4-Day Sahara Desert Group Tour.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure, final price, and payment instructions by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.a: The 8-day Marrakech Adventure & Sahara Desert tour is 359 EUR per person, based on shared/group transport and shared accommodation throughout.

items.q: Is this the same as booking the 5-day tour and the 4-day Sahara tour separately?
items.a: It covers the same ground as both, but as one combined itinerary at a bundled price lower than booking each separately, with a single continuous booking rather than two.

items.q: Do I need to pack differently for the desert days?
items.a: Yes — pack a small overnight bag for Days 5–7 and leave your main luggage securely stored at the Marrakech hostel, which keeps the desert loop light and simple.

items.q: How many nights are in the Sahara desert camp?
items.a: One night, on Day 6, after the camel trek into the Erg Chebbi dunes near Merzouga.

items.q: Is the return drive from Merzouga to Marrakech a long day?
items.a: Yes — at around 560 km and 8.5 hours with stops, Day 7 is the longest single driving day of the tour, broken up by a stop in Ouarzazate.

items.q: Can I do the desert loop first and the Marrakech excursions after?
items.a: The order can be adjusted on request, subject to availability on both legs — ask us when booking if you'd prefer to start with the Sahara.
